turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Namaste sir, kaise madad karun aaj?

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Mujhe apna Jupiter Active check karwana hai aur transaction Shield bhi activate chahiye.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Abhi hum KhedVyapaar aur NirKist pe check kar rahe hain, thoda ruk jaiye.

turns.speaker: CUS
turns.text: Yaar mera Razorpay Active mein issue hai aur JivDhan bhi nahi chal raha, maine upi lite try kiya tha.

turns.speaker: AGT
turns.text: Theek hai, hum interest rate Plus aur TavLaabh se resolve kar denge.
